title: Senior Engineering Manager - Loyalty Product
description: Back to jobs New Senior Engineering Manager - Loyalty Product New York, NY Apply WHO WE ARE Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com. Role Overview Zeta Global is seeking a hands-on Senior Engineering Manager to lead the Loyalty product that powers the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP). Reporting to Sr. Director, Engineering, this leader will own the technical execution, architecture, roadmap, and delivery for one or more core loyalty features. The role requires strong technical judgment, exceptional engineering leadership, and the ability to drive complex initiatives across multiple engineering teams. Zeta Loyalty helps brands move beyond static loyalty programs with intelligent experiences designed to deepen engagement. The next gen Zeta Loyalty platform is envisioned to be AI-powered and agentic. This is a technical leadership role. The Senior Engineering Manager is expected to remain actively involved in architecture, design reviews, technical decision-making, and production operations while developing engineers and technical leads and delivering reliable Loyalty product capabilities at scale. Loyalty Product Mission Zeta Loyalty provides a configurable program definition, member foundation, reference data, rules engine, and offer capabilities required to launch enterprise grade loyalty programs. Rather than simply managing points, this product creates a flexible loyalty platform that enables brands to define their program, reward customer behaviors, and evolve their loyalty strategy without requiring custom engineering. The key mission of the product is tightly integrating with other services of the ZMP, such as identity, events, messaging and seamlessly executing the loyalty program rules based on user behavior. Additionally, there is an urgent need to integrate Loyalty with AthenaOS, Zeta’s AI-powered assistant, to bring predictive intelligence, real-time activation, conversational AI into the loyalty domain. Scope of Ownership Own the complete Loyalty product suite, which includes, but not limited to: Customizable loyalty programs Configurable reward rules Flexible tiering structure Reward points tracking Tight Integration with system notification & user messaging frameworks Omnichannel support Unified ZMP Identity Unified ZMP Analytics The Senior Engineering Manager is accountable for the architecture, implementation, operational excellence, observability, monitoring & reliability of the owned products. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership Lead the architecture and technical direction for assigned domains. Translate product strategy into executable engineering roadmaps. Participate in quarterly planning and deliver the workloads on a timely manner, with high quality Drive technical design for services, APIs, schemas, background jobs. Review designs and ensure alignment with platform architecture and engineering standards. Identify scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability risks. Champion reusable solutions and eliminate unnecessary duplication across different features. Engineering Leadership Build and lead a high-performing team of engineers and technical leads. Coach and develop engineers through mentoring, technical guidance, and regular feedback. Establish clear ownership, accountability, and engineering best practices within the team. Foster a culture of operational excellence, engineering quality, and continuous improvement. Balance new investments with operational responsibilities and technical debt. Work with other engineering teams to transform the Loyalty product into a seamlessly integrated ZMP offering Cross-Team Collaboration Partner with Product and Engineering teams, Architecture, SRE, DevOps, Security, and FinOps teams. Coordinate delivery of initiatives that span multiple engineering teams. Resolve technical dependencies and implementation challenges. Drive alignment around platform standards and engineering best practices. Communicate technical trade-offs, priorities, and delivery risks clearly. Reliability, Security, and Operational Excellence Ensure the product services & components meet availability, latency, scalability, and recovery objectives. Embed observability, monitoring, capacity planning, and operational readiness into platform design. Improve tenant isolation, workload fairness, and platform resiliency. Partner with Security teams to build secure-by-default platform capabilities. Drive continuous improvements in operational efficiency, reliability, and cloud cost optimization. Success Measures Success will be measured through: Delivery of Loyalty roadmap commitments Hire engineers, build and lead a team dedicated to development of the Loyalty product as per agreed plan Product availability, reliability, and operational health Improved developer productivity and satisfaction Successful migrations and retirement of legacy services Team engagement, growth, and engineering effectiveness Required Qualifications Significant experience building and operating large-scale distributed platforms or multi-tenant SaaS systems. Experience leading engineering teams responsible for application full-stack development. Strong technical expertise in distributed systems, APIs, cloud-native architectures, and shared platform services. Experience designing and operating highly available production services. Experience partnering with multiple engineering teams to deliver shared capabilities. Strong operational knowledge of observability, incident management, and production readiness. Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and grow technical leaders. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience building marketing technology, customer-data, analytics, or large-scale SaaS platforms. Experience with agentic applications, AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, Snowflake, Iceberg, PostgreSQL, Redis, Node.js, React.js, or similar technologies. Experience with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices. BENEFITS & PERKS Unlimited PTO Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage Employee Equity Employee Discounts, Virtual Wellness Classes, and Pet Insurance And more!! SALARY RANGE The salary range for this role is $225,000 - $240,000, depending on location and experience. How do you know if you have a disability? A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to: Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally) Autoimmune disorder, for example, lupus, fibromyalgia, rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS Blind or low vision Cancer (past or present) Cardiovascular or heart disease Celiac disease Cerebral palsy Deaf or serious difficulty hearing Diabetes Disfigurement, for example, disfigurement caused by burns, wounds, accidents, or congenital disorders Epilepsy or other seizure disorder Gastrointestinal disorders, for example, Crohn's Disease, irritable bowel syndrome Intellectual or developmental disability Mental health conditions, for example, depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety disorder, schizophrenia, PTSD Missing limbs or partially missing limbs Mobility impairment, benefiting from the use of a wheelchair, scooter, walker, leg brace(s) and/or other supports Nervous system condition, for example, migraine headaches, Parkinson’s disease, multiple sclerosis (MS) Neurodivergence, for example, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), autism spectrum disorder, dyslexia, dyspraxia, other learning disabilities Partial or complete paralysis (any cause) Pulmonary or respiratory conditions, for example, tuberculosis, asthma, emphysema Short stature (dwarfism) Traumatic brain injury Disability Status Select...
